title: These Stocks Are Today’s Movers: Strategy, Robinhood, Oracle, Palantir, Nvidia, Disney, MP Materials, and More
text: Stocks were rising Monday after the U.S. manufacturing sector expanded for the first time in 12 months.  Fellow crypto-linked stocks  Coinbase Global  and  Robinhood Markets  were down 2.7% and 7.5%, respectively.  The slump made Robinhood the worst performer in the  on Monday.
